svg.text: How a student's request moves through the Team 4C Next.js application, the joint FastAPI backend and the data and model services

g.text: ES256 · kid in JWKS · iss · aud · scope · lifetime ≤ 300 s · single-use jti · production allowlist

svg.text: • Local demo ports: Next.js 3000, FastAPI 8001, Ollama 11434. Qdrant runs embedded inside the backend process
• The browser never calls the backend. Next.js checks the session and workspace ownership, then signs a
• The backend trusts only the token's workspace_id: every query filters Qdrant, the ingest registry and
• The Next.js app keeps two logical backend clients (Team A ingestion, Team B query; separate URLs and token
audiences). In the integrated demo both point to the same FastAPI process.
• Only Next.js reads or writes MongoDB. The FastAPI backend has no MongoDB dependency.
• In local/demo storage mode the backend uses in-process FakeRedis and embedded Qdrant; servers for them are
used only in external storage mode. The demo ran over HTTP on localhost.
• Team 4A / 4B labels follow the original team responsibilities; per-file authorship inside the joint backend
• Hardened for a controlled single host; not deployed to production.
EduCopilot — Multi-Modal Educational Intelligence Copilot · Accion Labs industry project (2026) · verified final integrated build, local demo configuration (not a production deployment)
